title: DeskPilot Ticket Record
description: Schema every row of tickets.csv (and any future appended batch) must satisfy. Used by scripts/append_and_retrain.py to validate new data before it is merged into the training set.

query_text.description: Free-text request as typed by the user. This is the primary model input.

category.description: The target label for the catalog-item classification head. NOTE: adding a brand-new category to future data requires updating this enum AND re-running training with an updated output layer size - documented in scripts/append_and_retrain.py.

department.description: Free-form in this version; treated as categorical and one-hot/embedded at train time. Unseen departments at inference time fall back to an <UNK> embedding bucket.
